name: Kopački Rit
description: Floodplain where the Drava meets the Danube, right against the Serbian and Hungarian borders — one of the largest intact wetlands in Europe. White-tailed eagles, black storks, and a boardwalk that goes out into standing water.
getting: Twenty minutes north of Osijek by car. Boat trips run from the visitor centre when levels allow; spring flood is the good time and also the time the boardwalk closes.
